title: Projektetage Description Morph
description: Fix projektetage intro: long description does not morph into short description on goal slide. Root cause: duplicate data-id on flow interactive wrapper vs h2.
summary:
Fixed projektetage intro long→short description not morphing on the goal slide.

Root cause: flow intro dispositions put reveal.js `data-id` on both the full-width `.presentation-interactive-disposition` wrapper and the inner `h2`. The auto-animate matcher paired the DIV wrappers (wrong geometry) instead of the text nodes; single-line descriptions (`data-id="description"`) were affected while multi-line titles used distinct line ids.

Fix: set `revealMorphId` only when a disposition has a declared canvas frame (`declaredRect !== undefined`). Flow morph anchors stay on leaf text nodes.

Tests: intro morph DOM asserts no wrapper `data-id` for description; unit test for flow vs canvas `revealMorphId`. Intro vitest subset passes.
